title: Items
doc: Pickups placed in levels: ammunition, weapons, health, armour and power-ups.

sections.name: #Items
sections.doc: Each entry starts at $Class Name:; the list ends at #End.

fields.name: $Class Name:
fields.doc: Unique item class name used by levels.

fields.name: $HUD Msg Name:
fields.doc: Localised name shown on pickup, written as XSTR(id, "text").

fields.name: $Pickup Msg Single:
fields.doc: Localised single player pickup message, XSTR(id, "text").

fields.name: $Pickup Msg W&A Single:
fields.doc: Localised single player message when the item gives a weapon and ammunition.

fields.name: $Pickup Msg W&A Multi:
fields.doc: Localised multiplayer message when the item gives a weapon and ammunition.

fields.name: $Count:
fields.doc: Amount given in single player (rounds, health points and so on).

fields.name: $Count Multi:
fields.doc: Amount given in multiplayer; defaults to $Count.

fields.name: $Respawn Time:
fields.doc: Respawn delay in seconds; -1 never respawns.

fields.name: $Pickup Sound:

parts.doc: sound file name; "" means none (then nothing else follows)
minimum distance in metres (only when a file is given)
volume scale (only when a file is given)

fields.doc: Sound on pickup: file, minimum distance, volume.

fields.name: $Ammo For:
fields.doc: Weapon whose ammunition this item gives.

fields.name: $Flags:
fields.doc: Item flags; an unknown flag name stops the game.
